items.title: European gas prices hit 1-month lows as Trump pauses Iran strikes
items.summary: Investing.com - European wholesale natural gas prices slipped to one-month lows on Tuesday, tracking a relentless deflationary wave across the broader energy complex as U.S. President Donald Trump dialed back the threat of further military strikes against Iran and brokered fresh peace talks between Russia and Ukraine.

items.title: Euro yields linger  at 1-month lows as sinking oil calms inflation jitters
items.summary: Investing.com - Eurozone government bond yields traded flat on Tuesday, with benchmark German borrowing costs hovering near their lowest levels in over a month and a half, as a sustained collapse in global crude oil prices provided fixed-income desks with a powerful disinflationary buffer ahead of a critical U.S. inflation report.

items.title: European shares inch toward record highs as sinking oil eases inflation anxiety
items.summary: Investing.com - European shares advanced on Tuesday, to inch toward a fresh record high, as a sustained collapse in global crude oil prices lifted margin pressures off continental balance sheets ahead of a highly anticipated U.S. inflation report.

items.title: Oil prices dip below $90 as Trump comments fuel Iran peace hopes
items.summary: Investing.com - Oil prices fell below $90 a barrel for the first time since August on Tuesday, after U.S. President Donald Trump signaled that fresh American attacks on Iran were not necessary, bolstering hopes for a de-escalation of tensions in the Middle East.

items.title: Occidental beats Q3 forecasts as production offsets lower crude prices
items.summary: Investing.com -- Occidental Petroleum Corporation (NYSE:OXY) delivered a decisive third-quarter earnings beat on Monday, lifted by operational outperformance in its core shale basins and substantial debt-reduction progress. The Houston-based producer posted adjusted earnings of $1.91 per share, topping analyst expectations of $1.34 by $0.57, while revenue reached $6.77 billion against a projected $6.61 billion.

items.title: Is Procter & Gamble's Beauty Momentum Enough to Lift Growth?
items.summary: PG's Beauty business posts 5% organic sales growth in Q1 FY27, fueled by Pantene and SK-II. Can this momentum boost overall growth?

items.title: Colgate vs. Chipotle: Which Is the Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: A defensive staple and a fast-casual growth name have both been overshadowed by tech’s run, but one looks poised for a comeback.

items.title: U.S. consumer prices seen rising 3.8% year-on-year in October - Truflation
items.summary: Investing.com - U.S. consumer prices are estimated to have risen by 3.8% in the twelve months to October and 0.3% month-on-month, amid ongoing upward pressure from elevated energy costs caused by the Iran war, according to Truflation predictions.
